mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_language_evidence (work_id, kind, source, lang, confidence, raw) VALUES (#{e.workId}, #{e.kind}, #{e.source}, #{e.lang}, #{e.confidence}, #{e.raw}) ON CONFLICT (work_id, kind, source) DO UPDATE SET lang = EXCLUDED.lang, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, raw = EXCLUDED.raw
mapper.select: SELECT work_id, kind, source, lang, confidence, raw FROM work_language_evidence WHERE work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY kind, source
mapper.update: UPDATE work SET language = #{lang}, language_source = #{source}, language_decided_at = now() WHERE id = #{workId}
